verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat product, so posting via an incoming webhook URL is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents such a URL. Messages are posted through the Buzz CLI, the ACP harness, or Nostr clients signing events over NIP-29/NIP-42, and the admin API uses signed NIP-98 auth rather than tokens. These are adjacent posting paths or developer building blocks, not a simple webhook URL, so they earn no credit.
